label: Careers at AtomsAI
title: Building the next global AI company from India
intro: Come solve hard problems in speech, real-time infrastructure, and the products thousands of businesses open every morning. Work that reaches real people on real phone lines, at a scale few teams see.

sections.title: The scale is real. So are the problems
intro: More than a billion conversations a year run through what we build. Every one crosses a live phone network, reaches a person who won’t wait, and matters to a business counting on the outcome.
If that sounds like the interesting part, read on.

blocks.title: Make AI better at conversation
body: Build speech models and conversational intelligence that handle accents, interruptions, and phone-quality audio. Your training data is a billion real calls a year.
blocks.label: Speech & conversational AI

blocks.title: Make it work at scale
body: Run the real-time infrastructure under every call. Milliseconds matter when a person is waiting on the line.
blocks.label: Infrastructure

blocks.title: Make it useful to people
body: Turn the models into products people open every morning. Thousands of businesses already do.
blocks.label: Applications

blocks.title: Take it to the world
body: Take what we build to the businesses that need it. Customers in 20+ countries, and far more who haven’t heard of us yet.
blocks.label: Go-to-market

sections.title: Your work should go further than your desk
sections.label: How we work
intro: Six things we hold to. They're how we decide what to build and who to build it with.

blocks.title: Own meaningful problems
body: You get a problem, not a ticket, and the room to solve it.

blocks.title: Work across disciplines
body: Researchers, engineers, and designers sit on the same problem, not in separate queues.

blocks.title: Ship, then learn
body: Production is the test. What you learn there decides what you build next.

blocks.title: Think independently
body: A good argument beats seniority. Bring one.

blocks.title: Move with purpose
body: We pick the few things that matter and move quickly on them.

blocks.title: Care about the outcome
body: The job is done when the customer's problem is, not when the task closes.

sections.title: Five steps, no surprises
sections.label: How we hire
intro: Every step is a real conversation about the work. You'll always know where you are and what comes next.

blocks.title: Apply
body: Send what you've built or shipped. A person reads every application.
blocks.label: Step 1

blocks.title: Intro call
body: What you're looking for, what the team needs, and whether it's worth both our time.
blocks.label: Step 2

blocks.title: Craft conversation
body: A deep dive on your work with the people you'd work with.
blocks.label: Step 3

blocks.title: Work session
body: A real problem from the team, solved together. Take-home work is paid.
blocks.label: Step 4

blocks.title: Team and offer
body: Meet the wider team, ask anything, and get a decision quickly.
blocks.label: Step 5

sections.title: Where you could start
sections.label: Careers
intro: We hire in Bengaluru, our headquarters, and remotely across India and the US.

closing.title: Come build what's next
body: There’s a lot left to build. Come shape it.
